items.headline: Carrick wants more signings before September 1 deadline
items.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick says the club 'want' and 'need' more transfer business before summer window closes, having signed Santos, Tielemans, and Darlow.

items.headline: Manchester United beat Leeds United 5-4 on penalties in friendly
items.summary: United drew 1-1 with Leeds at Croke Park in Dublin before winning the penalty shootout 5-4. Joshua Zirkzee scored in regulation.
